The keyboard has built-in speakers on both sides, a control panel with buttons, a small screen, and a vertical strip of function labels.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the control panel showing the brand name 'ALPHA' and model 'JK-63-BK' in white text.
The control panel lists '255 RHYTHMS' and includes a list of song styles and numbers.
